summary: Apply both blocking findings: define a stable TOOLING_FAILURE findingId convention and move required guidance/test targets to the next-action prompt source instead of the thin dispatcher skill.

items.title: TOOLING_FAILURE overrides have no findingId source
items.rationale: The finding identifies a real missing data path: TOOLING_FAILURE artifacts may have no review findings, while OverrideCompletionEvidence still requires a non-empty findings array with findingId.
items.evidence: spec.json R3/R4 require finding fields and accepted_risk guidance but do not define how to populate findingId for parser_error or coverage_error TOOLING_FAILURE cases with zero blocking findings.

items.title: Test target conflicts with thin dispatcher skill architecture
items.rationale: The finding matches verified architecture: sdd-forge.flow is a thin dispatcher and per-step procedures belong to next-action prompt files.
items.evidence: src/skills/sdd-forge.flow/SKILL.md says per-step procedures live in sdd-forge flow get next-action, while src/flow/prompts/plan/test-review.md owns the test-review step instructions.
